Package model

Class ModelManager

java.lang.Object
model.ModelManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
Model, UnnamedPropertyChangeSubject
public class ModelManager extends Object implements Model
Main application model implementation that coordinates menu, orders, tables, ingredients, and server communication. Acts as the central business logic hub between managers and observers.

Version:
